key_concepts: Matter can change physical form when heated or cooled
Sublimation is the change from solid directly to gas without becoming liquid
Deposition is the change from gas directly to solid without becoming liquid
Sublimation is endothermic and feels cold compared to its surroundings
Deposition is exothermic and feels hot compared to its surroundings
Dry ice (solid carbon dioxide) undergoes sublimation
Moth balls or naphthalene balls undergo sublimation
Water vapor changing into snow or frost is deposition
Frost forming on freezer sides is deposition
Sublimation and deposition are physical changes
